qwixx.bonus_red_yellow: Bonus Row Red-Yellow (counts for both rows)
qwixx.bonus_green_blue: Bonus Row Green-Blue (counts for both rows)
qwixx.select_sheet_subtitle: Discover official editions, alternative layouts, and randomizer modes
qwixx.room_cross: Cross what you want, then tap Done
qwixx.reset_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset your score sheet?
qwixx.bonus_shield_desc: Automatically absorbs the next penalty miss (avoids -5 pts).
qwixx.bonus_self_desc: Immediately places the next available cross in this row.
qwixx.bonus_partner_desc: Immediately places the next available cross in the target partner row.

default.crossing: Cross numbers from left to right. White sum can be used in any row, colored dice only in matching color.
default.scoring: Row score increases with total crosses: 1=1, 2=3, 3=6, ..., 12=78 pts. Misses: -5 pts each.
default.tip: Focus on 2 main rows and prepare 5 crosses to unlock the row lock.

classic.crossing: Standard left-to-right crossing. White dice sum applies to any row; colored die plus white die applies to that color row only.
classic.tip: Try not to skip too many numbers early in your strong rows.

gemixxt_a.crossing: Numbers remain in order (2-12 / 12-2), but colors shift in segments! Colored dice can only be placed on cells of that exact color.
gemixxt_a.scoring: Score rows individually. Locking a row removes the die matching the color of that row's lock box.
gemixxt_a.tip: Keep an eye on the color transitions to plan your colored dice combinations.

gemixxt_b.crossing: Row colors are uniform, but numbers are scrambled! Cross strictly from left to right according to the printed layout.
gemixxt_b.scoring: Rows are locked with their rightmost number once at least 5 crosses are placed.
gemixxt_b.tip: Check ahead carefully: numbers jump around unpredictably, so plan your jumps wisely.

big_points.crossing: Bonus rows can be crossed if the corresponding number in at least one adjacent color row is already marked.
big_points.scoring: Every cross in a bonus row adds to BOTH adjacent color row counts (e.g. Red-Yellow adds +1 to Red AND +1 to Yellow, up to 120 pts!).
big_points.tip: Fill numbers in adjacent color rows first to unlock massive bonus crosses.

connected_stairs.crossing: 11 stair fields form a continuous diagonal across all rows with a golden border. Cross them normally left-to-right.
connected_stairs.scoring: Crossed stair fields score as an independent 5th bonus category using the standard point formula (up to +66 pts).
connected_stairs.tip: Target the diagonal stair cells whenever possible to earn huge 5th category bonus points.

connected_chains.crossing: Crossing a linked chain cell immediately forces a free cross in the connected partner cell in the other row.
connected_chains.scoring: Standard row scoring minus penalty misses.
connected_chains.tip: Trigger chains to leap forward and earn extra marks in other rows without spending dice.

double_sub.crossing: Every number has a secondary sub-box. If the main number is crossed and rolled again, you can check its sub-box.
double_sub.scoring: Sub-boxes add full extra crosses to that row's final count (up to 16+ crosses).
double_sub.tip: Use duplicate rolls to supercharge your completed numbers.

double_numbers.crossing: Designated boxes contain double numbers that count as 2 crosses immediately when marked.
double_numbers.scoring: Standard scoring with accelerated row count progression.
double_numbers.tip: Prioritize double number boxes to quickly reach the 5 crosses needed to lock.

bonus.crossing: Special bonus icons grant instant perks when crossed (extra crosses, shields against misses, or doubling).
bonus.scoring: Bonus effects enhance your final score or mitigate penalties.
bonus.tip: Align your roll choices with the bonus icons for tactical advantages.

longo.crossing: Cross numbers from left to right (2–16 / 16–2). When the white dice roll your Lucky Number, cross the next free number in the row with the fewest crosses!
longo.scoring: Standard triangular scoring for up to 16 crosses (up to 136 pts per row). Locking requires 6 crosses and one of the last two numbers (15/16 or 3/2).
longo.tip: Watch the white dice rolls for your Lucky Numbers to gain valuable extra crosses in your lagging rows!

random_mix.crossing: Dynamically generated balanced random layout with shuffled numbers per row.
random_mix.scoring: Standard triangular scoring and rightmost lock rules.
random_mix.tip: Analyze the generated sequence carefully before your first roll!

classic.name: Qwixx Classic
classic.desc: Standard layout with 4 rows (Red & Yellow ascending 2-12, Green & Blue descending 12-2).

gemixxt_a.name: Gemixxt — Multi-Color
gemixxt_a.desc: Numbers are sorted normally, but row colors change in segments. Choose between Block 1 & Block 2.

gemixxt_b.name: Gemixxt — Mixed Numbers
gemixxt_b.desc: Row colors are uniform, but numbers are scrambled. Choose between Block 1, Block 2, or Block 3.

big_points.name: Big Points
big_points.desc: Includes 2 two-colored bonus rows. Crosses in bonus rows count towards BOTH adjacent rows (up to 120 pts per row!).

connected_stairs.name: Connected — Stairs
connected_stairs.desc: 11 stair fields form a diagonal across all rows. Crossed stair fields score as a 5th bonus category (up to +66 pts).

connected_chains.name: Connected — Chains
connected_chains.desc: Connected cells link pairs across rows: crossing one forces crossing the linked target cell immediately.

double_sub.name: Double — Sub-Boxes
double_sub.desc: Each number has a sub-box. If already crossed and rolled again, you can check the sub-box for extra points.

double_numbers.name: Double — Double Numbers
double_numbers.desc: Designated fields contain double numbers that count as 2 crosses at once.

bonus.name: Bonus Icons
bonus.desc: Special icons trigger chain actions, instant free crosses, or shields against penalty misses.

longo.name: Qwixx Longo
longo.desc: Official Longo block with 15 numbers (2–16), 8-sided D8 dice, and 2 individual Lucky Numbers.

random_mix.name: Randomizer (Custom Mix)
random_mix.desc: Generates a fresh, balanced scrambled layout for all four rows with a single tap.
